Guides have Wilderness First Responder training and provide interpretative hikes and safe adventures for all ages and experience levels.

quotes.author: Annindita Palaus - Google Review
quotes.text: The tour was really fun and the guides were super friendly and helpful. They have all kinds of winter gear to lend in case you don't have enough warm layers. The campfire and reindeer hotdogs for lunch is a great addition. Our guide Erica was very sweet and she even gave me her gloves and hand warmers since I forgot mine in the car and my mittens were not that great.

quotes.author: Melanie Moriarty-Woodward - Facebook Review
quotes.text: This was absolutely the icing on the cake. Our last day in Alaska and we could not ask for a better send off. The Blue Ice Glacier tour was so worth it and Erika was such a fantastic guide. The sights were breath taking and we got to have some fun on the snowmobiles. I would do this tour 100x over!

quotes.author: Irina Cowles - Google Review
quotes.text: This was absolutely amazing! We did the river float and wild rescue conservation experience. We had the best time. Erin and her husband are local guides and know the area so well. They shared their local knowledge with us and showed us the best of what Alaska has to offer.

quotes.author: Deanne Kindred - Google Review
quotes.text: This was the best experience we have ever had. The guide was so patient and knowledgeable. Our 10yr old said it was the coolest thing he has ever done. The views are breathtaking and the glacier is amazing! The highlight of our trip!!!

quotes.author: Jim Norton - Google Review
quotes.text: Erin and Justin were both extremely knowledgeable and friendly. Their love for their native Alaska is infectious. We had a great day on the Portage Lake raft and hike excursion and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
